members.name: ClearSurface
members.params: (Surface As IDirectDrawSurface4, RED As Byte, GREEN As Byte, BLUE As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Fill a DirectDraw surface with a solid color
notes: Uses DDBLTFX with DDBLT_COLORFILL. Takes RGB bytes.

members.name: CreateSurfaceFromFile
members.params: (ByVal Width As Long, ByVal Height As Long, ByVal strFile As String)

annotations.purpose: Load a BMP file into a DirectDraw offscreen surface
notes: Creates a surface in system memory, loads image via StdPicture, blits to surface via DC. Used for loading sprite sheets.

members.name: DDrawGrhtoSurface
members.params: (Surface As IDirectDrawSurface4, Grh As Grh, x As Integer, y As Integer, Center As Byte, Animate As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Draw a Grh sprite to a DirectDraw surface (opaque blit)
notes: Calculates source rect from GrhData, handles animation frame advancement. Opaque blit (no transparency). Used for ground layer tiles.

members.name: DDrawTransGrhtoSurface
members.params: (Surface As IDirectDrawSurface4, Grh As Grh, x As Integer, y As Integer, Center As Byte, Animate As Byte)

annotations.purpose: Draw a Grh sprite to a DirectDraw surface with transparency (color key)
notes: Same as DDrawGrhtoSurface but uses DDBLT_KEYSRC for transparent blitting. Color key is black (RGB 0,0,0). Used for characters, objects, upper tile layers.

annotations.purpose: Blit the back buffer to the primary surface (flip)
notes: Copies the rendered back buffer to the visible screen via the primary surface. Handles the main view offset (80px from window edge).

members.name: GetBitmapDimensions
members.params: (BmpFile As String, ByRef bmWidth As Long, ByRef bmHeight As Long)

annotations.purpose: Read width and height from a BMP file header
notes: Reads BITMAPFILEHEADER and BITMAPINFOHEADER structs. Used during surface creation.

annotations.purpose: Get the desktop window handle for screen resolution detection

members.name: DrawGrhtoHdc
members.params: (DestHdc As Long, Grh As Grh, x As Integer, y As Integer, Center As Byte, Animate As Byte, ROP As Long)

annotations.purpose: Draw a Grh sprite to a device context (HDC) for UI elements
notes: Used for rendering sprites in forms/dialogs (inventory icons, spell icons, etc.) rather than to the game viewport DirectDraw surface.

members.name: RenderScreen
members.params: (TileX As Integer, TileY As Integer, PixelOffsetX As Integer, PixelOffsetY As Integer)

annotations.purpose: Main render loop: draw all visible tiles, objects, and characters to the back buffer
notes: CRITICAL RENDERER. Three-pass rendering: 1) Ground layer (opaque blit of graphic(1) for all visible tiles). 2) Transparent layers: graphic(2) fringe tiles, objects on ground (ObjGrh), graphic(3) weather/top layer (only when raining). 3) Characters: composited as head+body+shield+weapon with walk animation offsets. Movement animation: MoveOffset decreases by 8px per frame toward 0. Viewport = (TileX-XWindow/2-screenbuffer) to (TileX+XWindow/2+screenbuffer). Each character's head is drawn at body position + HeadOffset.

annotations.purpose: Convert a tile-relative screen position to pixel position
notes: Returns x * TileSizeX (32). Simple multiplication helper.

annotations.purpose: Load all sprite sheet BMP files into DirectDraw surfaces
notes: Reads Grh.ini for file number to filename mapping, loads each BMP as a DirectDraw surface. These surfaces are then referenced by GrhData entries for sprite rendering.
